/ri rab de yang/ shar shel/ lho bai ḍūr+ya/ nub dngul/ byang gser te/ phyogs bzhi rin po che sna bzhi las grub pa yin/ lha rnams gnas pa'i ri'i rgyal po ri rab de yang*/ ri bo khri phrag drug cus bskor zhing mdzes par byas pa bang rim gyi lha gnas rnams su bkod pa bzhin du yod de/ ngos bzhi rin po che la byas pa/ steng du 'bab chu dang*/ lteng ka dang*/ pad ma'i rdzing dang*/ rin po che'i 'phreng ba'i 'od kyis gsal bar byas pa yid du 'ong ba yod do/ /ri rab kyi steng gi phyogs bzhi na rtse mo bzhi yod de/ shar gyi rtse mo shel/ lho yi rtse mo bai ḍūr+ya/ /nub kyi rtse mo dngul/ byang gi rtse mo gser las grub pa/ chur dang*/ zheng du dpag tshad nyi shu rtsa lnga re re/ mtha' skor du dpag tshad lnga brgya re re yod cing*/ /ri rab las dpag tshad phyed dang lnga lngas gyen du 'phags pa la/ gnod sbyin lag na rdo rje rnams gnas so/ /ri rab kyi kha la ni sum cu rtsa gsum pa rnams gnas so/ /ri rab kyi dpag tshad brgyad khri'i phyi rol na gnya' shing 'dzin gyi ri ni chu las dpag tshad bzhi khri steng byung bas/ ri rgyal lhun po'i phyed slebs pa tsam du 'phags so/ /zheng yang dpag tshad bzhi khri yod de gyen du 'phags pa dang mnyam mo/ /de nas dpag tshad bzhi khṛ phyi rol na gshol mda' 'dzin zhes bya'i ri ni rgya mtsho las dpag tshad nyi khri gyen du 'phags so/ /zheng du yang de dang 'dra'o/ /de nas dpag tshad nyi khri'i phyi rol na ri'i rgyal po seng ldeng can zhes bya ba ni rgya mtsho las dpag tshad khri gyen du 'phags shing*/ zhing yang de dang 'dra'o/ /de nas dpag tshad khri yi phyi rol na/ ri yi rgyal po lta na sdug zhes bya ba ni/ dpag tshad lnga stong rgya mtsho'i steng du 'phags shing zhing yang de dang 'dra'o/ /de nas dpag tshad lnga stong gi phyi rol na/ ri'i rgyal po rta rna ri zhes bya ba ni/ dpag tshad nyi stong lnga brgya ni rgya mtsho'i steng du 'phags shing*/

zheng yang de dang 'dra'o/ /de nas dpag tshad nyis stong lnga brgya'i phyi rol na/ ri'i rgyal po rnam par 'dud ces bya ni/ dpag tshad stong nyis brgya lnga bcu ni rgya mtsho'i steng 'phags shing*/ zheng yang de dang 'dra'o/ /des nas dpag tshad stong nyis brgya lnga bcu'i phyi rol na/ ri yi rgyal po mu khyud 'dzin zhes bya ba ni/ dpag tshad drug brgya nyi shu rtsa lnga rgya mtsho'i steng du 'phags shing zheng yang de dang 'dra'o/ /ri bdun po kun kyang gser las grub cing*/ dpag tshad brgyad khri ni chu'i 'og gser gyi sa gzhi la brten cing*/ chu las steng du 'phags pa kun kyang*/ phyed phyed kyis phyi ma rnams dma' zhing ri'i bar rnams phyed phyed kyis phyi ma rnams dog pa yin la/ ri de bdun yang*/ mdzes pa lta na sdug pa/ yid du 'ong ba/ steng du rgyal chen bzhi'i lha rnams kyi grong dang grong khyer dang*/ ljongs rnams gnas so/ /ri rab kyi ri shar phyogs gnya' shing 'dzin gyi steng na/ rgyal po yul 'khor srung gi pho brang khor yug srung zhes bya ba yod do/ /ri rab kyi lho phyogs gnya' shing 'dzin gyi steng na/ rgyal po 'phags skyes kyi pho brang 'phags par skyes pa zhes bya ba yod do/ /ri rab nub phyogs gnya' shing 'dzin gyi steng na/ rgyal po spyan mi bzang gi pho brang 'khor sna tshogs gzugs bya ba yod do/ /ri rab kyi byang phyogs gnya' shing 'dzin gyi steng na/ rgyal po rnam thos sras kyi pho brang lcang lo can bya ba de/ thams cad kyang zheng dang chur dpag tshad nyis brgya lnga bcu re re/ mtha' skor du dpag tshad stong yod pa dbyibs legs lta na sdug pa/ 'bab chu dang*/ shing dang*/ me tog dang*/ shing dang chu la gnas pa'i bya yid du 'ong ba rnams kyis skad snyan pa 'byin pa la sogs pa longs spyod bsam gyis mi khyab ste 'dir bri bar mi nus so/ /rol mtsho nang mo'i zheng la dpag tshad brgyad khri yod cing gnya' shing 'dzin gyi phyi rol nas rim pa bzhin gnya' shing 'dzin gyi rol mtsho ni zheng du dpag tshad bzhi khri gshol mda' 'dzin gyi rol mtsho ni zheng du dpag tshad nyis khri/

seng ldeng can gyi rol mtsho'i zheng ni dpag tshad khri/ lta na sdug gi rol mtsho'i zheng dpag tshad lnga stong*/ rta rna'i rol mtsho'i zheng ni dpag tshad nyis stong lnga brgya/ rnam par 'dud kyi rol mtsho'i zheng ni stong nyis brgya lnga bcu yod de/ rol mtsho bdun po kun kyang zabs su dpag tshad brgyad khri yod de gser gyi sa gzhi la brten te dbyibs legs pa blta na sdug pa yin la chu bsil zhing sbrang rtsi lta bus gang ste klu'i rgyal po dgongs pa rgyas par 'dug go /mdor na rol mtsho kun kyang chu zheng phyi ma rnams phyed phyed kyis phri ba yin no/ /mu khyud 'dzin gyi phyi rol na ba tshwa'i rgya mtsho ni khor yug gi lcags ri'i bar du zheng la dpag tshad gsum 'bum dang nyi khri dang nyis stong zabs su dpag tshad brgyad khri yod pa gser gyi sa gzhi la brten no/ /khor yug gi ri ni phyi rol gyi rgya mtsho bar te dpag tshad brgyad khri ni chu'i 'og gser gyi sa gzhi la brten no/ / mdzes pa lcags las grub pa yin te/ de'i steng na gnod sbyin gos sngon po can gnas so/ / gnyis pa mdor bstan pa ni/ 'dod lha ris drug yod pa de la/ rgyal chen bzhi'i lha rnams kyi lha gnas bzhi la re re la bcu bcu yod de/ de yang 'phreng thogs/ yol thog rtag myos dang*/ pi wang gsum pa'i lha rnams ri rab kyi bang rim la rim pa bzhin gnas nas longs spyod dang ldan pa yin no/ /gsum pa skye ba'i rgyu mdor bstan pa ni/ lha de rnams kyang srog gcod pa spangs shing sbyin pa dang ldan pa'i las kyis bskyed pa yin pas/ 'phreng thogs kyi lha nas rim pa bzhin las rgyu 'bras brjod par bya'o/ /bzhi pa rgyas par bshad pa la bzhi/ 'phreng thogs kyi lha bshad pa dang*/ yol thogs kyi lha bshad pa dang*/ rtag myos kyi lha bshad pa dang*/ pi wang gsum pa'i lha bshad pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis ste/ ming rgyu dang bcas pa dang*/

spyi yi longs spyod skye ba'i tshul lo/ /dang po la bcu las/ zur na gnas zhes bya ba ni/ lha gnas bcu yod pa'i dang po pa'i char 'dir gnas pa'i phyogs lho 'dzam bu gling bya ba yin de/ de phyogs na gnas pa zur na gnas zhes bya'o/ /de dang nye ba na/ mtha' la gnas zhes bya ba gnas so/ /lha gnas gzhan rnams kyang g.yas skor du rim pa bzhi gnas pa yin te/ nub tu 'bras bu nye 'tsho/ dkar po spyod/ shar du thams cad dgar gnas/ 'gro mgyogs gnyis so/ /byang du yul la chags/ 'dod la chags/ yid g.yo/ nye ba'i tshal bya ba rnams gnas so/ /de yang gang la la zhig gis 'chi kha ma'i tshe dad pa dang ldan pas yid ma g.yeng bar dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su song na zur la gnas bya ba der ni nges par skye'o/ /gnyis pa/ mtha' la gnas zhes bya ba der skye ba'i rgyu ni/ tshul khrims dang ldan pa la chu bo la brgal ba'i phyir gru dang zam pa byin pa dang*/ skye bo mi bde ba chu la sgrol zhing sdig pa la mi 'jug na des 'grub par 'gyur ro/ / gsum pa 'bras bu nye bar 'tsho ba'i gnas su ni tshul khrims dang ldan pa gang la la zhig gi bkres skom dang ldan pa la/ snying brtse bas bza' shing gi 'bras bu byin nas der skye bar 'gyur ro/ /bzhi pa yon tan dkar po spyod pa bya ba de ru skye ba'i rgyu ni/ yid rab tu dang bas sangs rgyas sam mchod rten la me tog snyim pa gang phul bas skye bar 'gyur ro/ /lnga pa/ thams cad dga' der skye ba'i rgyu ni/ tshul khrims dang ldan pa gang la la zhig gis/ rang gis bskyed pa'am/ nyos pa'i me tog rgyal ba sangs rgyas la me tog gis mchod par skye bar 'gyur ro/ /drug pa 'gro mgyogs ni/ nags tshal la me mched pas srog chags dag tshig pas nyen pa na la la zhig gi me la chu gtor nas tshig pa las thar bar byed na dang*/ de nyid du shi ba la thug pa rnams kyi srog 'jigs pa la bskyabs na/ 'gro mgyogs kyi gnas su skye bar 'gyur ro/

/bdun pa yul chags ni tshul khrims dang ldan pa la la zhig gis mdza' bshes la sogs pa/ so sor bye zhing 'khrug pa dang*/ gcig la gcig gnod pa byed pa gzhan dag gi bar byed cing bsdum par byed na/ yul la chags pa'i lha gnas su skye bar 'gyur ro/ /brgyad pa/ 'dod la chags pa'i lha gnas su skye ba'i rgyu ni dad pas chos nyan pa'i rgyu las byung ba yin no/ /dgu pa yid g.yo'i gnas der skye ba'i rgyu ni/ dkon mchog gsum dang mchod rten gyi gnas yid gus pa dang bcas pas phyag dar legs par byas pas skye'o/ /bcu pa nye ba'i tshal ni tshul khrims dang ldan zhing dge 'dun la zhing bzang por shes pa dag gis/ chos gos bya ba'i phyir gser la sogs pa cung zad phul na nye ba'i tshal du 'gro bar 'gyur ro/ /gnyis pa spyi yi longs spyod ni/ lha de rnams ni rgyu las bzang po spyad pa'i stobs kyis/ 'bras bu bde ba myong ba ni bsam gyis mi khyab ste/ 'khor los bsgyur ba'i longs spyod thams cad kyis/ 'phreng thog gi lha gcig gi longs spyod kyi bcu drug gi cha gcig gi yang dper bya bar nus pa ma yin no/ /lha gnas de ni rin po che sna tshogs kyi tshal dang*/ me tog gi rigs du mas brgyan cing mdzes par byas pa/ 'bab chu gtsang ma sna tshogs dang*/ sbrang chang dang rgun 'brum gyi 'bab chu sna tshogs rab tu 'bab pa/ ngag tu sgra snyan pa 'byin pa'i bya sna tshogs dang*/ bung bas sa phyogs thams cad khengs pa dang*/ rgyan dang gos dang bza' btung rnams kyang bsam pa tsam gyis lhun 'grub tu 'byung bar 'gyur zhing*/ mdzes pa lta na sdug pa'i lha'i bu mo brgya phrag du ma dag gis glu gar dang rnam pa sna tshogs pa'i mchod pa dang sil snyan sna tshogs sgrogs par byed do/ /lha gnas de na me long gi tshal bya ba yod pa nas ltas pas na me long gi nang du gzugs snang ba bzhin sngon byas pa'i las dang las de'i 'bras bu mtho ris ngan song gang du skye ba yang snang bar 'gyur ro/

/longs spyod dpag tu med pa dang ldan zhing rlung rgyu ba ltar gar 'gro bar 'dod pa'i gnas su thog pa med par rgyu'o/ /lha gnas 'dir skye ba'i tshul yang*/ lus kyi rtsib log nas zhag bdun na skye zhing*/ /de nas bde ba dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /gnyis pa yol thogs kyi lha bshad pa la gsum ste/ gnas bcu so so'i ming*/ so so'i rgyu/ spyi yi longs spyod do/ /dang po ming dang*/ gnyis pa rgyu gnyis dus gcig 'chad pas/ gnyis pa lag na yol thog gi lha gnas rnams su skye ba ni spyir srog gcod pa spangs pa dang sdom pa dang ldan pa'i thog tu/ bye brag tu ngos bzung ba ni/ dkon mchog gsum la yid dang ba dang ldan pas phyag 'tshal bar byed na gnas dang po pad ma'i nang du rgyu ba bya bar skye'o/ /sems can la phan par brtson pa snying rje'i sems dang ldan pa dag gis mchod rten la sgra snyan po dang dri zhim pos mchod na/ gnas gnyis pa nub sgra snyan pa bya bar skye bar 'gyur ro/ /dad pa dang rgyal ba sangs rgyas la gdugs phul na gsum pa sgra la chags bya bar skye bar 'gyur ro/ /mchod rten la ni dri chab phul na lha gnas bzhi pa dris dregs dga' ba bya bar skye bar 'gyur ro/ /tshad pa chen pos dge slong rnams gdungs pa'i dus su dge slong rnams rlung g.yab kyis g.yab cing rlung bsil mo byin cing lus bsil bar byas na gnas lnga pa rlung la spyod pa bya bar skye bar 'gyur ro/ /tshad pas gdungs nas ni skom pa'i dge slong dang*/ lam dang 'brog dgon par zhugs shing lus pa rnams la chu ril ba gang phul na gnas drug pa me tog 'phreng dga' bya bar skye'o/ /tshul khrims 'chal pa'i nad pa'i rim 'gros byas pas gnas bdun pa kun tu lta ba bya bar skye'o/ /bsad par 'os pa btson rar bcug nas gsod rgyur gnas pa dag nor zas kyis blus nas thar bar byas na/ lha gnas brgyad pa rtag tu dga' ba bya bar skye'o/

dkon mchog gsum zhing chen por shes nas gos mchog dri zhim po rnams phul zhing tshogs bsags na gnas dgu pa dri la chags pa bya bar skye'o/ /rgyal po la gnod pa byed pa'i mi dag bzung nas spyi gtsug nas bcings nas dpyangs pa sdug bsngal gyis non pa thar bar byas na/ lha gnas bcu pa spyi gtsug thar bya bar skye bar 'gyur ro/ /gsum pa spyi yi longs spyod ni/ lha 'di rnams kyi bde skyid ni/ snga ma phreng thog gi lha'i bde ba las/ shin tu 'phags pa yin te/ skye gnas kyang rdzus skyes dang ldan pa yin la/ rin po che sna tshogs kyi ri bo dang*/ ljon pa rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa 'od zer stong phrag du ma 'phro ba/ rol mo sna tshogs kyi sgra dang*/ kha nas sgra snyan pa du ma sgrog pa'i bya rnams kun kyi skad thos pas yid 'phrog par byed cing*/ yang yang thos kyang ngoms pa med do/ /btung ba rnam pa sna tshogs dang*/ 'bab chu rnam pa sna tshogs dang*/ de bzhin du bza' ba dang btung ba ni dpag tu med do/ kha dog sna tshogs yod pa'i gos rnams kun kyang*/ yang zhing reg na lus la bde ba yin no/ las sna tshogs pa'i spos rnams kyi ngad ldang zhing*/ rang gang 'dod pa'i rlung rnams ni rang 'dod pa'i dus kun tu ldang ngo*/ / gzugs mchog dang ldan zhing rgyan rnam pa sna tshogs kyis mdzes par byas pa'i lha mo rnams dang lhan cig tu rtse zhing dga' bar byed do/ /gzhan yang gzugs sdug pa dang*/ sgra snyan pa dang*/ dri zhim pa dang*/ ro mngar ba dang*/ reg bya 'jam pa la sogs pa yul lnga'i bde ba ni bsam pas dpag tu med pa rnams la longs spyod pas kyang*/ ngoms pa med pas phyir zhing sred pas rgyud 'brel bar byed pas yid ma tshim nas 'dod yon la bag med par spyod do/ /de'i tshe tshal na gnas pa'i bya lha'i skad du rtse ba zhes bya yod pa des lha rnams bag med pa la bskul ba'i phyir/ lha rnams la tshigs su bcad de smras pa/

bde ba thob pa'i lha de dag /bag med pa la ma bsten na/ /de ni bde las bde thob cing*/ /mya ngan 'das pa'i rjes su 'gro/ /bde ba'i mtha' de zad 'gyur cing*/ /'di la rtag tu ther zug med/ /de thob gzhal med khang rnams la/ /skyes bu mchog rnams chags ma byed/ /bsags pa thams cad tha mar zad/ /mtho ba'i mtha' ni tha mar rnyil/ /'du ba'i mtha' ni tha mar 'bral/ /skye ba rtag tu 'chi 'gyur bas/ / chos rnams kun kyi ngo bo nyid/ /skye dang 'jig pa 'di shes nas/ /bag med yid la ma byed cig /bag med myos pa'i sems can rnams/ /sdug las sdug bsngal dai 'gro'o/ /rtag tu bdag nyid bde 'dod na/ /'chi ba'i bar du dge ba byos/ / chos spyod bde ba yin no zhes/ /mkhas pa rnams kyis gdams pa yin/ /rgyu yi de nyid rnam ston pa/ sangs rgyas rnams kyis 'khor ba kun/ /rtag tu mi rtag mi brtan la/ /'gyur zhing tsha bar rtag tu gsungs/ /zhes bya rnams kyi smras pa thos nas yud tsam zhig bag med pa la ma bzhugs so/ /de nas yang yid mi brtan pa de bag med pa la bzhugs nas/ las ma zad bar du bde ba la spyod nas/ de nas srid pa gzhan du 'pho bar 'gyur ro/ /gsum pa rtag myos kyi lha bshad pa la gsum ste/ mdor bstan pa dang*/ bcu'i ming rgyu ྄dang bcas pa dang spyi yi longs spyod pa bshad pa'o/ /de la dang po mdor bstan pa ni/ yol thogs kyi lha bshad zin pa de nas gnas gsum pa rtag myos kyi lha gnas ni nang tshan la bcu yod pa de bshad par bya ste/ gnyis pa ming rgyu dang bcas pa la lha gnas bcu las/ dang po ni/ lha gnas dang po ni lhag par dga' ba zhes bya ba yin te/ der skye ba'i rgyu ni lha dang*/ gnod sbyin dang*/ yi dwags dang*/ srin po gnas pa'i shing ljon pa rang gis kyang mi gcod gzhan gyis bcad na yang gcod du mi bcol nas/ de rnams gnas dang ma bral bar byed cing*/ tshul khrims dang ldan pa ni der skye ba'o/

/gnyis pa ut+pal mdog bya ba ni tshul khrims dang ldan pa gang gis 'dis dkon mchog gsum gyi longs spyod bya'o snyam du bsam nas ut+pal bskyed par byas nas/ dad pa dang ldan pas dkon mchog gsum la phul nas sems dga' bar 'dzin pa gang yin pa de/ ut+pal mdog bya bar skye bar 'gyur ro/ /gsum pa pad ma dkar po spyod pa ni/ tshul khrims dang ldan pas pad ma'i tshal dkon mchog gsum la dad pas phul ba gang yin pa de ni pad ma dkar po spyod pa zhes bya ba'i lha gnas su skye bar 'gyur ro/ /bzhi pa pad dkar spyod pa ni/ yang dag par rab tu byung ba'i dge slong la rung ba'i tshon gyis kha dog bsgyur ba'i chos gos dmar po dad pas phul na/ dmar po spyod pa zhes bya ba'i lha gnas su skye bar 'gyur ro/ /lnga pa sna tshogs gnas ni tshul khrims dang ldan pa la bza' btung sna tshogs sbyin par byed pa gang yin pa de ni/ sna tshogs gnas zhes bya bar skyes te/ bde ba'i mchog rnam pa sna tshogs dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /drug pa mtho bar spyod ni/ legs par spyad pa'i las mngon par shes pa dag gis/ sems can la tsha ba dang grang ba las skyob pa'i gnas khang byas nas byin na mtho bar gnas zhes bya bar skye ba 'gyur ro/ /bdun pa chang rtag myos ni tshul khrims dang ldan pa legs pa'i las shes pa dag gis/ dge sbyong dang bram ze mchog med pa dag la/ lus tshim par byed pa'i bza' btung gya nom pa ster bar byed pa ni/ rgun chang gis rtag tu myos pa zhes par skyes so/ /brgyad pa yul la 'dod bya ba ni nad kyis thebs pa dag la nad kyi rkyen sman dang*/ yo byad dang*/ nad g.yog dag byin te nad sos pas nad pa dga' bar byed pa de/ lha gnas yul la 'dod bya bar skye bar 'gyur ro/ /dgu pa chu gsol gnas ni/ snying rje dang ldan pa dag gis sems can 'chi ka skom gyis gdungs pa dag la/ bu ram chu'am chu grang mo blud pas/

chu bsil gnas bya bar skye bar 'gyur ro/ /bcu pa brtan dga' zhes bya bar skye ba'i rgyu ni/ dge slong la sogs pa rnams 'khor la skyo ba bskyed par bya ba'i phyir/ mi ro'am/ mi ro lta bu bris pa gcig mdun na bzhag nas/ dge slong la sogs de rnams 'khor ba la yid nges par 'byung ba'i rkyen byas pas der skye bar 'gyur ro/ /gsum pa spyi'i longs spyod bshad pa ni/ rtag myos kyi lha gnas 'di rnams ni longs spyod thams cad phyogs gcig tu dper byas na/ gong du bshad pa'i lha gnas 'og ma 'phreng thog yol thog gnyis las bcu 'gyur gyis bde ba dang ldan pa dang*/ longs spyod dang ldan pa yin te/ yid du 'ong ba'am lha mo mdzes pa'i lha mo 'dod yon gyis myos ma rnams dang*/ bya sna tshogs dang*/ bung ba sbrang chang gis myos pa rnams dang snyan pa'i glu len/ gar byed pa yang*/ dus rtag tu yod pas/ dus rgyun du 'brel ba bzhin du gnas so/ ma dha ra dang*/ rin po che'i rgyan mdzes pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'khrol ba'i sgra yang sil sil du dus rgyun du sgrogs so/ /gzugs sdug pa sgra snyan dri zhim pa ro mngar ba reg bya 'jam pa/ yid tshim par byed pa'i chos la sogs pa/ 'dod pa'i yon tan drug po'i khyad par yid du 'ong ba rnams kyis dga' ba dus rtag tu 'phel lo/ / gzhan yang khang bzang sna tshogs dang*/ skyed mos tshal dang*/ me tog la sogs pa rnams kyang nyi ma bzhin du 'od rab tu 'bar zhing*/ yul gyi khyad par mdzes pa rnams ni bsam gyis mi khyab pa yod pas/ de rnams myong pa yin no/ /bzhi pa pi wang bzhi gsum pa'i lha bshad pa la bzhi/ mdor bstan pa dang*/ ming dang rgyu 'bras rgyas par bshad pa dang*/ rgyal chen bzhi'i gnas dang*/ kun tu rgyu ba'i lha bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni de nas lha gnas bzhi pa rgyal po chen po bzhi gnas pa'i pi wang gsum pa'i lha gnas dpag tu med pa'i longs spyod dang ldan pa gnyis sred pa dang ldan pa der skye ba'i rgyu 'bras lhan cig bshad par bya'o/

/gnyis pa la lha gnas bcu yod pa de la/ dang po dri dga' zhes bya bar skye ba'i rgyu ni kun dga'i ra ba dang*/ bu ram gyi dang*/ 'bra go yi dang*/ shing a 'bra'i skyed mos tshal phul tshad skye'o/ /las de'i 'bras bu skyed mos tshal mtshungs pa med pa dang ldan zhing longs spyod do/ /gnyis pa sgra snyan ni yang dag pa'i lta ba dang ldan pa gang gis log par lta ba la zhugs pa dag lta ba ngan pa de bzlog pa'i phyir chos bstan pas de dag kyang sangs rgyas la dad pa yud tsam zhig bskyed par byas na yang*/ sgra snyan zhes bya ba'i gnas su skyes nas longs spyod khyad par du yod pa ni/ gnas de na lha mo gzugs mdzes pa 'dzum zhing 'jo sgeg la mngon par dga' ba glu dbyangs kyi sgra snyan pa sgrogs pa rnams kyis bskor zhing*/ bya myos pa dang*/ bung ba mos rnar snyan pa'i sgra 'byin pa rnams kyis mdzes par byas pa yin no/ /gsum pa de la chags ni skom pa la chu byin pa dang*/ mgron po dag chu thung ba la/ lu ra dang*/ kri dang*/ sbrang bu mchu ring dag gis chu thung na dug chu nang du song nas/ de la chu 'thung na mgron po rnams 'chi bar dogs nas chu thung ba'i khron pa dag g.yog ste/ mgron po dag la dug gi 'jig pa med par bde bar byed pa/ gang yin de de la chags bya bar skyes te/ gnas de ni gzhan gyis mtshungs pa med pa'i ljon pa dang*/ bya rnams dang*/ ri bo rnams kyis brgyan pa yin no/ /bzhi pa skyor chu skyes ni snying rje dang ldan pa gang gis/ nad pa la sman byin pa dang*/ nad pa skom pas gdungs pa sgra ngar ngar por 'gag cing srog cung zad yod pa chu ster na/ skyor chur skyes bya ba'i gnas su skye ste/ tshal nyams dga' ba rnams su gcig nas gcig du 'gro zhing longs spyod dpag du med pa spyod cing khyad par du yang tshal me tog lnga pa bya ba na/ dus su dran par byed pa'i bya rnams yod pas/ lha 'dod yon la bag med pa rnams la 'diskad ces smras so/

/lha dag bde bas myos pa gang*/ /de dag la ni bde rtag med/ las kyi brgyar ni bcug gyur cing*/ /gti mug gis ni bslus pa rnams/ / 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas/ /'khrul 'khor bzhin du 'khyam par byed/ /lha dang lha yi 'jig rten nas/ /'chi bar 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal gang*/ /de ni dmyal las dmyal ba ru/ /de ni dper byar yod med do/ /bde mtha' rtag tu lhung bar go /'di dag ci zhig mi shes sam/ lha rnams 'chi med yul lta bur/ /bde bas rmongs rnams lta bar byed/ /skye dang 'chi ba'i 'jig rten ni/ /grangs su bgrang du yod med kyang*/ / sred pas yongs su bslus pa yin/ /mi rnams yid ni 'byung mi byed/ /ces pa'i bya'i sgra de thos pas yud tsam zhig yid la byas pa dang*/ yang bag med pa de nyid kyi dbang du 'gyur ro/ /lnga pa lus dkar ni/ lha gang dang mchod rten rnying pa zhig pa rnams la zha la dang bskang nus legs par byed na/ lus dkar zhes bya bar skye ste/ gnas de'i tshal rnams kha mdog dkar dmar rnams ma 'dres par so sor gnas ste/ lha de rnams kha dog ni dkar po yin ste/ tshal gyi nang du bzhugasapa'i tshe/ lus de yang tshal gyi kha dog bzhin du 'gyur ro/ /drug pa phan tshun dga' ldan bya ba der skye ba'i rgyu ni bdag nyid tshul khrims la spyod cing sbyin pa btang ba la byung ste/ gnas der skyes pas sna tshogs 'dres pa'i tshal dang ldan pas bde ba dpag tu med cing*/ lhag par yang 'dod pas myos pas lha mo rnams dang lhan cig rtse bas dus 'da' ba yin no/ /bdun pa yang dag chags spyod zhes bya ba der skye ba'i rgyu ni dge 'dun gyi zhal ta ba las byed pa tshul khrims dang ldan pa dag gis/ khyim pa dag gzengs bstod dga' bar byas/ dad par byas nas/ sbyin pa sbyin du bcug /tshul khrims srung du bcug nas dge ba la sbyar na gnas der skye zhing skye ba'i las thams cad kyang dran no/

/lha mo mdzes ma du mas bdag la btud nas kha rlang dri zhim pos nam mkha' 'geng zhing*/ lha dang lha mo rnams 'dod pa'i bde ba nyams su myong bar byed do/ /lha gnas 'dir so sor snang ba zhes bya ba'i ri yi rtse mo na rgyal po chen po 'phags skyes po bya ba gnas pa yin te/ mi yi 'jig rten na chos dang chos ma yin pa byed pa nyi ma gsal mi gsal gyi ltas la rtog par byed do/ /brgyad pa 'khor dang rnam spyod ni/ bdag nyid chos dang ldan zhing gzhan yang chos dang ldan zhing sbyin pa la 'god par byed na/ 'khor dang rnam spyod bya bar skye ste/ der ni longs spyod rnam pa du ma yis yul drug myos par byed pa yod do/ /dgu pa dkyil krung bcas skye bya ba der skye ba'i rgyu ni mu ge byung ba'i dus su bkres pa la zas sbyin pa dang*/ chur khyer ba 'byin pas skye ste/ 'dzam bu'i tshal bya ba la sogs nyams dga' bar 'bod pa zhes bya ba'i bya rnams yod pas lha'i bu rnams la/ / bzang po khyod ni legs par byon/ /khyod kyis legs byas byas dang ldan/ /tshul khrims rnam pa bdun bsrungs pa/ /de yi 'bras bu 'dir 'ongs so/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pa tshig bzung bar 'os pa mang po smra bar byed do/ /bcu pa longs spyod ldan bya ba'i gnas su skye ba'i rgyu ni 'thab phrol dang*/ shi ba la thug pa dag thar bar byed pas skye ba'o/ /de na longs spyod dpag tu med pa yod cing gzugs kyis lhag par myos shing me long ltar gsal ba'i tshal du rgyal po chen po mig mi bzang gnas nas 'jig rten gyi bya ba la rtog par byed do/ /gsum pa rgyal po bzhi'i gnas ni/ yul 'khor srung ni shar phyogs na gnas te/ lus ngan ni byang phyogs lcang lo can du gnas so/ /gzhan yang yul 'khor srung gi pho brang yul sa srung bya ba dang*/ 'phags skyes kyi gnas 'phags par skyes bya ba dang*/ mi mi bzang gi gnas/ sna tshogs gzugs bya ba dang*/

lus ngan gyi gnas/ lcang lo can bya ba rnams ni/ ngos dang zheng dang chur dpag tshad nyis brgya lnga bcu/ mtha' skor du dpag tshad stong yod pa/ gnya' shing 'dzin gyi steng*/ phyogs bzhir gnas pa yin te/ dpag tu med pa'i bkod pa dang*/ longs spyod dang ldan pa yin no/ /bzhi pa kun rgyu ba'i lha bshad pa la bzhi las/ dang po skar ma'i grangs ni/ rgyal chen bzhi po de'i 'khor kun tu rgyu ba'i lha bye ba phrag ni sum cu rtsa drug yod de/ lha de rnams gnas pa'i gzhal yas khang ni gza' dang skar ma zhes 'jig rten na grags so/ /de la skar ma'i grangs ni bye ba sum cu rtsa drug yod/ che ba ni rgyang grags bco brgyad chung ba ni rgyang grags gsum mo/ /phal cher ni bcu dang bcu gnyis pa yin no/ /de'i nang du lha'i bu rnams rtse zhing dga' mgur longs spyod do/ /gnyis pa nyi zla'i bkod pa ni/ nyi ma dang zla ba gnyis ni lha'i gnas khang yin te/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor ni chur dang*/ zheng du dpag tshad lnga bcu rtsa gcig re re/ mtha' skor du dpag tshad lnga bcu rtsa gsum/ rngams su dpag tshad phyed dang drug dang dpag tshad bco brgyad kyi cha gcig yod de/ dbyibs legs lta na sdug pa me shel las grub pa yin no/ /de'i nang du lha'i bu nyi ma 'khor dang bcas pa gnas so/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor ni chur dang*/ zhing dang*/ tha skor du dpag tshad lnga bcu re re/ rngams su dpag tshad phyed dang drug dang*/ dpag tshad kyi bco brgyad kyi cha gcig yod de/ dbyibs legs lta na sdug pa chu shel las grub pa'i nang du lha'i bu zla ba 'khor dang bcas pa gnas so/ /skar ma dang*/ nyi ma dang zla ba de rnams kyi nang du ni skyed mos tshal dang*/ grong khyer dang lteng khas brgyan cing longs spyod dang ldan zhing*/ nang gi sa gzhi yang kha dog sna tshogs pa yid du 'ong ba/ 'jam pa ni shing bal gyis 'dam ma bzhin rkang pa bzhag na ni nem gyis byed bkyag na par gyis byed pa me tog man+da ra bas pus mo nub pa tsam du longs te/

lam srang dang*/ rdzing bu rin po che sna tshogs la byas pa dang*/ bdud rtsi bzhi dang*/ sbrang rtsi dang*/ sbrang gis gang ba/ me tog sna tshogs dang*/ bya gzugs sna tshogs yod pa kha nas snyan pa'i sgra 'byin pa dang*/ pi wang dang gling bu la sogs pa rol mo sna tshogs dang*/ lha'am lha'i bu mo rnams kyis ci 'dod pa bsam pa tsam gyis lag du'o/ /lha'i bu mo yid du 'ong ba brgya stong dang brtse bar byed do/ /de rnams kyang rlung gi 'khor los nam mkha' la 'dres pas ri rab la 'khor bar byed pa yin no/ /zhar la zla ba 'phel 'grib kyi tshul ni nub ba lang spyod na nam phyed pa dang*/ byang sgra mi snyan na nyi ma nub pa dang*/ shar lus 'phags na nyi ma phyed pa dang*/ lho 'dzam bu gling nyi ma shar ba rnams dus gcig pa yin pa dang*/ gzhan la yang dus des 'gre'o/ /nyi ma'i 'od zla ba la phog pas zla ba'i rang gi grib mas 'gebs pas gnam stong na nyi ma zla ba thams cad kyis phrad cing 'grog pas zla ba mi mthong la/ tshes gcig nas nyi zla je steng la 'gro bas zla ba 'phel bar byed la/ tshes bco lnga la so sor 'gro bas/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor rdzogs shing*/ tshes bcu drug nas yang je nyer 'gro bas zla ba 'grib par byed do/ /bzhi pa bye brag gi rgyu ni/ nyi zla skar ma'i nang gi lhar skye ba'i rgyu ni tshul khrims dang ldan pa snying brtse can gyis khyad par du dkon mchog la sgron me byin pa'i mthus skye'o/ /gzhan yang 'jig rten skyong ba bzhi po ni tshul khrims dang bsod nams gzhan ces lhag par khyad par du 'phags pa spyad pas rnam pa sna tshogs pa'i longs spyod bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang ldan te/ sems kyi kun tu rtog pas dge ba byas pa'i grangs bzhin du yul gyi longs spyod kyang de 'drar snang zhing*/ 'di ltar lha gnas bzhi bcur skyes nas bde ba mang po spyad kyang*/ las de zad nas ngan 'gror lhung bar byed do/
/lnga pa tshe tshad rgyu mthun bcas pa ni/ rgyal chen rigs bzhi'i lha 'di rnams kyi tshe ni*/ mi rnams kyi lo lnga bcu rgyal chen rigs bzhi'i zhag gcig /zhag de lta bu sum cu la zla ba gcig

/de bcu gnyis lo gcig byas pa'i/ rang gi lo lnga brgya thub ste mi yi lor brtsis na ni/ sa ya gcig dang*/ 'bum phrag brgyad thub bo/ /de nas shi nas lan grangs gzhan la myong 'gyur gyi las kyis/ dmyal ba yi dwags dud 'gro rnams su skyes la/ mi rnams dang skal ba mnyam par mir skyes na ni rgyu mthun gyi las kyis/ phyugs cing skal bzang gi 'khor mang po dang ldan pa dang*/ dus rtag tu chos la dga' bar 'gyur ro/ /sum cu rtsa gsum la lnga ste/ 'tshams sbyor ba dang brgya byin gyi rgyu 'bras dang*/ gnas kyi khyad par dang*/ so so yi rgyas bshad dang*/ spyi yi longs spyod bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ rgyal chen rigs bzhi'i lha bshad pa'i rjes nyid nas/ sum cu rtsa gsum du skye bar 'gyur ba'i rgyu dang 'bras bu yang rnam par dbye bar bya'o/ /gang gis tshul khrims rnam pa bdun ma nyams pa ma ral ba skyon med par bsrung ba dang*/ dgra bcom pa dang*/ pha ma dang*/ nad pa dang*/ bsam gtan pa dang*/ 'gog pa las langs pa la sbyin pa dus la babs pa sbyin pas mchod par byas pa dang*/ tshad med bzhi bsgom pa dang*/ mchod sbyin stong phrag du ma dag byas pa dag gis mig stong dang ldan pa'i brgya byin du skye bar 'gyur ro/ /de ni lha rnams kyi rgyal po'i dbang phyug yin te/ bye ba dgu bcu rtsa dgu yod pa'i lha mo mdzes ma rnams kyis bskor nas mchod par byed de/ de rnams ni mchog gi bde ba la sogs pa yin te/ de la sogs pa lha'i rin po che rnams dang bde ba bla na med pa la dbang byed pa yin no/ /ri rgyal lhun po'i rtse la zheng dang chur dpag tshad brgyad khri yod pa'i steng du mdzes pa lta na sdug pa'i dbus su/ lha yi mdun sa chos bzang bya ba'i brgya byin gyi lha'i gnas de yang dpag tshad lnga brgya yod de/ rin po che sna tshogs kyi rang bzhin las grub pa yin te/ kha khyer ni bai ḍūr+ya/ ka ba ni byi ru lan kan ni shel las byas shing spug gis brgyan/

rtsig pa ni gser btso ma la byas shing rdo rjes brgyan te nor bus dag par byed pa dang*/ khri ni pad ma ra ga la byas shing an da rnyil gyis mdzes par spras pa'o/ /de nas lha'i dbang po brgya byin lha mo'i tshogs dang bcas pa 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga la spyod cing rtse bar byed pa'i skyed mos tshal bzhi yod de/ bud med dga' ba'i tshal dang*/ kun dga' tshal dang*/ dpe med kyi tshal dang*/ thams cad 'byor ba'i tshal dang*/ tshal bzhi yod de de la sogs pa tshal dang nye ba'i tshal dang bcas pa dpag tu med pa yod de/ thams cad kyang dpag tu med pa sna tshogs pa'i ljon pa dang ni/ dpag tu med pa'i rdzing bu du mas brgyan pa/ zla bzang dang*/ pad ma chen po dang*/ man dha ra la sogs pa rnams ni rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i me tog du ma dang ldan pa ni sdong po 'dam rdzab med pa'i thang las skyes pas brgyan pa dang*/ sgra snyan cing 'jam pa legs par sbyar ba'i chos kyi tshig smra ba'i bung ba myos pa bai ḍūr+ya'i mdog lta bu dang*/ bya rkang pa ni bai ḍūr+ya/ sgro ni mthon ka /mchu ni spug /mig ni byi ru'i kha dog lta bu dang*/ bya kha dog sna tshogs pa'i bya rnam pa du mas gang ba dang*/ dus dang dus su med par tshal rnams na/ lha'i gos dang rnam pa sna tshogs dang*/ rgyan dang*/ zas kha dog bzhi dang ldan pa yid la ci 'dod pa bzhin 'byung ba dang*/ khang pa brtsegs pa mdzes pa yid du 'ong ba dpag tu med pa dang*/ bar thams cad rin po che sna tshogs kyi bye ma bdal ba dang*/ de rnams ni/ mnyen ba bkra ba ched du gnyer nas bshams pa bzhin du yod do/ /gzhan yang nyi ma dang zla ba las kyang lhag pa'i 'od dang ldan pa'i sna tshogs pa'i bzhon pa du ma dang*/ dus kyi rjes su 'brang ba'i tsan dan la sogs pa'i sna tshogs pa dri dpe byar med pa rnams dang ldan te/ lha rnams kyi mnga' bdag ko'u shi ka yis lha rnams la legs par ston pa dang 'dra ste/

sna tshogs pa'i bde ba nyams su myong bar byed pa yin no/ /brgya byin de'i sras chos bzang na yod pa'i lha kun kyang*/ lha rnams kyi bde ba dpe med pa dang ldan pa yin te/ der skye ba'i rgyu ni srog gcod pa dang*/ ma byin par len pa spangs pa dang*/ sbyin pa gtong ba dang*/ dkon mchog la gus pas lha der bskyed pa yin no/ /mthor gnas su skye ba'i rgyu ni/ gzhan dag srog gcod pa dang*/ ma byin len pa byed pa spong ba la sbyor ba'i las kyis skyes te/ lha gnas der ni bza' btung sna tshogs dang*/ chu bo mdzes pa du ma dang*/ shing ljon pa dang*/ tshal sna tshogs kyis bsten pa bde ba du ma dang ldan pa gcig yin no/ /ri rtser gnas bya bar skye ba'i rgyu ni bdag nyid gsod pa dang bu ram gyi shing rku ba spang shing*/ gzhan yang gsod pa dang bur shing rku ba spong ba la sbyor bas der skye ba'o/ /lha gnas de na skyed mos tshal drug yod de/ yul lnga yang yid du 'ong ba du ma dang*/ lha mo mdzes ma yid 'phrog pa du ma dang rab tu mos par byed pa'i bde ba dpag tu med do/ /lta na sdug zhes bya bar gnas pa'i lha rnams su skye ba'i rgyu ni mtshon dang chu las ni gzhan gyi srog 'don pa dang*/ nyams nga ba'i ma byin pa len pa spangs pas lha der skye ste/ grong khyer dpag tshad khri yod pa de yang gser gyi rang bzhin las grub pa/ dgu brgya dgu bcu go dgu'i sgo yod pa yang gnod sbyin gyis srung zhing yin pa/ grong khyer gyi srang mnyam zhing*/ rdzing bu dang*/ skyed mos tshal dang*/ bzhi mdo rnams su lha mo yid du 'ong ba rnams kyis mdzes par byas shing sil snyan brdung ba/ bar bar rnams su dril bu g.yer ka dang*/ mu tig 'phreng bas mdzes par byas pa/ rin po che'i shing rta rnams zhon cing 'gro ba la sogs pa phun sum tshogs pa'i bde ba dang ldan pa yin no/ /phyogs gcig na gnas pa'i lhar skye ba'i rgyu ni/

rang nyid dbul yang nor rdzas tshul bzhin bkren pa rnams la sbyin par byed pa dang*/ log par g.yem pa dag gzhan gyis bzung nas srog gcod pa la thug pa dag thar bar byed pa'o/ /der skyes pa'i lha de rnams ni 'od dang rgyan rnams kun kyang lha gzhan rnams las lhag par gyur pa yin no/ /lha'i bu mo mdzes ma rnams kyis mchod par byed pa la sogs pa bde ba rmad du byung ba yin no/ /shing gseb kyi lha der skye ba'i rgyu ni/ pha ma dang*/ rgyal ba sangs rgyas la dad pa byed cing mchod pa 'bul ba dang rkun po bzung nas gsod pa la thug pa dag thar par byed pa dang*/ sdig grogs dang mi 'grog ste/ gzhan la phan par sems pa rnams dang lhan cig spyod pa'i las kyis lha gnas der drangs pa yin te/ der ni ljon pa'i tshogs rnams dang*/ khang bzang rnams dang*/ rdzing bu rnams kyang rang gar 'dod pa'i gnas su bya bzhin du rang gi rjes su 'brang nas 'ong zhing*/ lha mo rnams dang*/ lha dang bcas pa rnams la/ bde ba du ma yod pa ni dpe med cing dpe las 'das pa yin no/ /shing rta sna tshogs su skye ba'i rgyu ni las rgyu 'bras mi shes pa dag gis sku gzugs dang mchod rten la phul ba'i longs spyod rnams 'phrog par byed pa dag la/ sangs rgyas la dad pa'i mi dag gis/ tshig snyn zhing 'jam pa dag gis mi de sdig pa de las bzlog par byas pas skye ste/ gnas der rin po che sna tshogs las byas pa'i shing rta rnams kyi nang du rdzing bu bcas shing de'i nang rnam par bkra ba'i me tog du ma dang ni ldan/ rin po che sa la ma'i ljon pa dang ldan zhing*/ gang tshe lha ma yin dang g.yul 'gyed pa cir byed pa ni/ tshal der longs spyod sna tshogs lon pa yin no/ /'di man chad mchan gsol lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de byang chub sems dpa' zla ba zhes bya bar gyur pa'i tshe/ su da sa yi bu rkang bkra spyi zan btul ba'i 'phrin las 'jug par rig nas smras pa/

'o na chos 'dod pas de dang rjes su mthun pa'i spyod pa la mkhas par bya ste/ chos nyan pa'i rigs su ltos shig /rab tu dma' ba'i stan la 'dug /'dul ba'i dpal ni rnam par bskyed/ /dga' dang ldan pa'i mig gis blta/ /tshig gi bdud rtsi 'thung ba bzhin/ /gus pa bskyed cing rtse gcig 'dud/ /rab tu dwangs la dri med yid/ / nad pas sman pa'i tshig nyan bzhin/ /rim 'gro bskyed de chos nyon cig /ces gsungs so/ /rtsod dus rgyal ba'i bstan la mos pa gang*/ /blang dor chos la blo gros 'jug pa'i thabs/ /dam chos dran pa nyer bzhag bstan bcos 'di/ / rgyal sras rang byung rdo rjes gsungs pa la/ /rnam bshad tshig gi 'od zer cung zad 'di/ /bdag dang de yi rjes 'jug skye bo kun/ /dge sdig blang dor rgyu 'bras shes bya'i phyir/ /rang dgar ma bsam 'grel don bzhin bshad/ /sngar sbyang bag chags nam mkha' yangs pa las/ /thos bsam rta bdun rlung gi shugs drangs nas/ /rnam bshad nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor shar gyur te/ /shes bya'i gnas lugs gsal ba'i 'od zer 'dis/ /mi shes rmongs pa skar tshogs zil gnon cing*/ /bdag gzhan blo mun myur du bsal nas ni/ /sdug bsngal 'dam rdzab myur du skam byas nas/ /thar pa'i myu gu myur du smin byed yin/ /bdag blo thos bsam sgron mes cung gsal yang*/ /mkhas grub khyad 'phags 'dzoms sar rab tu blun/ /de phyir bshad la nor 'khrul gyur na'ang*/ /bla ma mchog dang mkhas la bzod par gsol/ /de ltar bshad pa'i dge ba'i 'od zer gyis/ / 'gro ba'i mi shes mun pa rab bsal nas/ /shes bya'i gnas lugs thams cad rab gzigs pa'i/ /kun mkhyen rgyal po'i go 'phang thob par shog /dran pa nye bar gzhag pa'i don snang bar byed pa'i tshig le'ur mdzad pa'i rnam par bshad pa 'di ni/ bla ma dam pa thugs mkhyen pa'i shes rab la lung rigs gi don gsal zhing*/ gsung legs bshad 'od zer gyis gdul bya'i blo'i pad mo'i kha 'byed pa/

lung dang rigs pa'i sgo nas/ log rtog rgol ba'i wa tshogs thams cad skrag par byed pa'i dpal mi yi seng ge chen po bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa'i gsung gi bdud rtsis cung zad tshim pa/ chos smra ba'i ban sprang*/ shes rab rin chen zhes bya bas/ gdan sa chen po kar ma'i gtsug ( lag ) khang du sbyar ba 'di/ re zhig yongs su rdzogs so/ /dus thams cad du dge bar gyur cig /sarba maṅga laṃ// // mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ shes rab rin chen gyi gsung*/ dam pa'i chos dran pa nye bar bzhag pa'i bstan bcos kyi 'grel pa/ - PAGE 202 -- PAGE 203 -- PAGE 91 -
